# ChaloSchools

> ChaloSchools is a complete school management ERP for K-12 schools in India, built by Inspace Edu Solutions Private Limited. It handles admissions, fee management, attendance, timetable scheduling, staff/HR, and parent communication in a single platform, with dedicated apps for parents (Chaloschools), teachers (AnsApp), and school management (C-365).

ChaloSchools serves 200+ schools across India, impacting 1.5M+ students, with 99.9% platform uptime. It is ISO 27001:2022 certified and built in line with India's DPDP Act 2023 data protection principles.

## Product

- [Product Tour](https://chaloschools.com/product): overview of all 14 modules — Admissions, Fee Management, Attendance, Timetable, Parent App, Reports & Analytics, Academic & Examination, Student Management, Staff Management, Payroll, Academic Inventory Tracking, Communication Management, Inspace Performance Insights, and AI Secretary.
- [Pricing](https://chaloschools.com/pricing): per-student, per-year pricing plans.
- [Platform Capabilities](https://chaloschools.com/platform-capabilities): 20+ AI-powered capabilities including AI Rephrase, Voice Broadcast, KYP (Know Your Parent) verification, and Enterprise Cloud infrastructure.
- [Compare](https://chaloschools.com/compare): how ChaloSchools compares to spreadsheets, WhatsApp-based coordination, and generic ERP systems.
- [Data Protection & Security](https://chaloschools.com/security): ISO 27001:2022 certification and DPDP Act 2023 compliance details.
